h: All Israel Stand Together Within the Everlasting Covenant

p: אַתֶּם נִצָּבִים הַיּוֹם וְגוֹמֵר (דְּבָרִים כט, ט)
After the six haftaros of consolation
which correspond to the six middos
corresponding to the middah of Malchus.
And the conclusion of the first haftarah of consolation
הוּא אִישׁ לֹא נֶעְדָּר (יְשַׁעְיָה מ, כו)
after the parshah of the passing-over of the rebukes,
which is the culmination of the exiles, it says:
"You are standing today, all of you,
וּבְמִדְרַשׁ תַּנְחוּמָא פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (תַּנְחוּמָא נִצָּבִים א)
And Midrash Tanchuma on this parshah (Tanchuma, Nitzavim 1)
"The wicked are overturned and are no more,
but the house of the righteous will stand" (Mishlei 12:7).
'Do not rejoice over me, my enemy,
for though I fell, I have risen.'"
this itself will be the cause of the rising,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ לְשׁוֹן חֲזַ״ל (מַכּוֹת ז, ב)
along the lines of the expression of Chazal (Makkos 7b):
"a descent that is for the sake of an ascent";
"For seven times the tzaddik falls and rises,"
And here it enumerates seven levels,
corresponding to all the seven middos.
that the fall will be the cause of the rising,
נָפְלָה וְלֹא תוֹסִיף לִנְפּוֹל עוֹד (עָמוֹס ה, ב)
"She has fallen and will fall no more (Amos 5:2);
as is expounded in Tanchuma on this parshah (ibid.):
so you too, when it is dark for you,
an everlasting light is destined to shine for you."
meaning that you will all be in one band;
אָז עַל יְדֵי זֶה יִהְיֶה הַגְּאוּלָּה
then through this the redemption will come.
that all will merit to greet the Shechinah,
וְכִי לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים אָכְלוּ וְכוּלֵּי (שְׁמוֹת יח, יב)
"And did they eat before God?" etc. (Shemos 18:12);
it is as if they enjoyed the radiance of the Shechinah;
as we said regarding the parshah of the passing-over,
And likewise in the parshah of teshuvah
נִזְכַּר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר פְּעָמִים ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ
"Hashem your God" is mentioned twelve times,
הוּא כְּנֶגֶד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שִׁבְטֵי יָהּ
corresponds to the twelve tribes of Yah
and to the twelve months of the year;
which alludes that all of Yisrael,
and at all times, are clarified
in that the Name Havayah is your leader.
Six: "Your heads, your tribes, your elders," etc.,
"Even though I have appointed over you
all of you are equal before Me";
as it will be in the future,
from the smallest of them to the greatest of them."
For this is the main intent of the words of Torah:
that it be engraved in the heart to know Hashem,
that there is One Who created the world.
אֵין זָקֵן אֶלָּא מִי שֶׁקָּנָה חָכְמָה (קִידּוּשִׁין לב, ב)
"an elder is none other than one who has acquired wisdom" (Kiddushin 32b);
"all of you are equal before Me,"
has a portion in the words of Torah,
"'An inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov' (Devarim 33:4);
'the congregation of Yannai' is not written here,
as referring to the simple folk,
"'And to the house of Yaakov their sins' (Yeshayahu 58:1):
And this is "every man of Yisrael,"
שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד יֵשׁ לוֹ חֵלֶק בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה
that every one has a portion in the words of Torah,
"An inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov."
Seven: "Your little ones, your wives," etc.,
אַף שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם חֵלֶק בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה
even though they have no portion in the words of Torah,
since they are not people of Torah,
nevertheless they too will be clarified
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
As we find with Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him:
"his servant, the elder of his household,
הַמּוֹשֵׁל בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כד, ב)
who ruled over all that he had" (Bereishis 24:2);
that he was master over his yetzer like him.
וְלֹא כַּחֲמוֹרוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן דּוֹסָא
and not like the donkey of Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa
and of Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair";
And this is what it says: that the convert,
and even the woodchopper and water-drawer,
And this is the purpose of all the exiles:
that not one will be missing.
"For you to pass into the covenant of Hashem your God
אֲשֶׁר ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּוֹרֵת עִמְּךָ הַיּוֹם (דְּבָרִים כט, יא)
which Hashem your God makes with you today" (Devarim 29:11):
that all the souls of Yisrael be clarified,
so that not one is missing,
even the little ones and the women
all will be clarified for the good.
he is still in the midst of hard labor,
that it comes from Hashem Yisbarach,
Who looks ahead toward the good,
that not one will be missing.

Seven Levels of Standing Before Hashem
The Covenant Leaves No Soul Behind
